question: What kinds of devotion must be absent in those deemed unfit recipients?
premises: Absence of devotion to the kula is specified.
Absence of devotion to the guru is specified.
Both conditions characterize the same unfit person.
inference: One devoid of devotion to both kula and guru is unfit.
plain_english: To one who is devoid of devotion to the kula and deprived of devotion to the guru.
